title: Implement motion/activity characteristic mappings (K.3.2)
description:
Add to gatt_ipso.c static table, motion/activity characteristics:

- Acceleration 0x2713 -> 3313/5702, m/s2
- Step Counter 0x2ACF -> 26257/5700, count
- Cadence (RSC) 0x2A53 -> 3346/5700, /min
- Speed (RSC) 0x2A53 -> 3346/5701, m/s (note: same UUID, different resource)
- Stride Length 0x2A53 -> 3330/5700, m
- Cadence (CSC) 0x2A5B -> 3346/5700, /min
- Wheel Revolutions 0x2A5B -> 3340/5700, count

Note: 0x2A53 and 0x2A5B are multi-value characteristics; primary mapping only.

~8 entries. Reference: spec/appendix-gatt-ipso.md K.3.2
